title: Additive derived stalk cohomology along a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let j:Y→Z be an isomorphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], y∈Y and i∈Z. Degree-i derived stalk cohomology at j(y), followed by forgetting scalars, is naturally isomorphic to derived pullback along j followed by degree-i derived stalk cohomology at y and forgetting scalars. The isomorphism is constructed by lifting the restriction-stalk natural isomorphism through localization and the specified universal pullback counit [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport, def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition].

source.place: Affine reduction and equation-bc; Tag 0098 lemma-stalk-pullback-modules; Tag 0D5S lemma-pullback-composition

proof.text: Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensorPullback with restrictFunctor. Restriction along the inverse j gives an equivalence: compose restrictFunctorComp, restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorId to construct the unit and counit.

Exactness of this equivalence gives the exact derived-category functor. The specified counit is a universal left-derived counit and its ordinary functor inverts quasi-isomorphisms. Mathlib isIso_of_isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts proves invertibility.

Mathlib restrictStalkNatIso and the adjoint comparison identify additive stalks. Map this iso to complexes. Exact forgetting commutes with homology via ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso. Exact-stalk localization factors and the pullback counit give the natural isomorphism on complexes, which Localization.liftNatIso lifts to the derived category.

def isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIso j]
    (y : Y) (i : ℤ) :
    comparisonStalkCohomology Z (j y) i ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Z.presheaf.stalk (j y))) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
      derivedPullback j ⋙ comparisonStalkCohomology Y y i ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
